changes: Added JSON-safe validate progress and heartbeat events, per-command timeout diagnostics, validation lock stale-owner hardening, forced-exit cleanup behavior, and infra_failure classification for runner/watchdog failures.
usage: Run lattice validate --story=<storyId> --json or story_advance --phase=TEST; long validate commands now emit progress and heartbeat on stderr while JSON stdout remains parseable.
expectedOutcome: Long active validation should not be killed as idle work; true hangs should still fail by command timeout or lifecycle max timeout with named diagnostics.
actualTranscript: Worktree CLI story_advance --phase=TEST printed validate progress and heartbeat lines, ran 43/43 configured commands, wrote PASS test evidence, and advanced B-2fb7 to TEST. done_prepare after merge-main reran 43/43 validation and DONE-required validation successfully.
outcomeDiff: No user-visible gap in the worktree CLI path. One operational pitfall remains: the global lattice symlink points at main until the branch is merged/rebuilt, so self-hosting verification must use the worktree CLI before merge.
limitations: No production or remote Authority claim is made; this is local Proofbound verification only. Global lattice will not show the new behavior until this branch is merged into main and the canonical dist is rebuilt.
pitfalls: The main stall was not a code regression after the fix; global lattice was still pointing at main, so formal story_advance initially used stale CLI code and hit the old idle watchdog. Use node packages/main/dist/cli.js from the story worktree for self-hosting verification before merge, and keep the per-command timeout/max-timeout distinction explicit so heartbeat cannot grant unlimited execution.
